source.method: Visual review of the locked V40 printed step 9 panel and its rivet insert/push/lock closeup, rendered privately; no source pixels are copied into authored output
source.observation: The ultrasonic module sits just behind the front wall with its two transducers pointing forward through the wall's two large openings. The H plate lies directly behind the module. Two R3080 rivets enter from the front through the wall's small end holes into the H plate, clamping the module between them.

placement.module: Board plane parallel to the front wall, its front face against the inner face of the wall, the two transducer cans pointing forward (+X) through the openings with their axes on the opening height and centred across the car; the crystal edge is up and the rear connector edge is down.
placement.plateH: Flat behind the module, its front face against the module rear face, long axis across the car (installed Y), its end holes on the wall's small-hole axes; the notch faces down over the module's rear connector.
placement.rivets: Each rivet head bears on the wall's outer face at a small end hole, shank pointing inward (-X) through the wall and the H plate end hole beside the module end.
placement.stackOrderNote: The accepted ordered stack lists rivet, module, wall, H plate. The physical order from the front is rivet head, wall, module, H plate; the stack is used for membership and ownership only.

approach.note: Nonphysical exploded staging only; module and H plate come from behind the wall, the rivets from the front.

limitations: The module is the additive instructional revision derived from the supplied-hardware photographs: a 46.2 x 20.5 mm board, transducer cans 28.4 mm apart and 1.6 mm off the board centre line toward the crystal edge, a crystal on that edge and a 4-pin connector on the rear of the opposite edge. Values are DERIVED to about 2 to 6 percent, not manufacturer verified; the exact OEM identity and revision stay unresolved and the 5 V versus V40 3V3 conflict stays open
The traced wall openings are 30 mm apart and the cans 28.4 mm apart, so each can sits 0.8 mm off its opening centre with 0.4 mm of radial slack; this is a derived relation, not a measured fit

The connector edge is placed down because a connector-up board would put its connector about 5 mm into the deck; V40 does not show the connector, and the rear connector passing through the Plate H notch (notch 14.3 mm, connector about 14.0 mm) is a derived coincidence, not a source-stated relation

Plate H is the additive instructional revision: its photographed outline is about 20.5 mm tall with a notch about 5.2 mm deep, against 23.14 mm and 6.36 mm in the accepted M6 outline; the M6 hole centres, notch width and notch floor are kept, and the end-hole axes remain the rivet axes
Rear integrated circuits and passives of the module, about 1.3 to 1.8 mm tall, are not represented, so Plate H is shown resting on the board rear face
The rivets pass beside the module ends, so the module is held between wall and H plate by clamping, not by its own corner holes
The rivet proxy shows only its unlocked body with the pin lifted; the locked pin state is not represented, and no rivet strength, grip range or retention is claimed
The accepted ordered stack lists the module before the wall, which is not the physical order shown in V40; it is used for membership only
No installation sweep or fit is claimed

knownBlockers.note: With the supplied-hardware revisions the cumulative state still contains forbidden positive-volume overlaps, so the S09 closure is refused. Volumes are for rpi5 and are re-measured by the independent verifier.

overlaps.note: The pan horn arm (x up to about 170 mm, z -2.2..0, y within about 17 mm of the hub) occupies the same space as Plate H (x 168.4..170.4, top at z +0.2). With the notch up the overlap falls to about 45 mm3 but the plate then meets the module connector.
The module crystal (about 4.5 mm across, 3.8 mm tall) reaches into wall material below the traced top slot (3.5 mm tall).
Plate H top is 0.2 mm above the deck underside; the derived plate height is uncertain by about 0.5 mm and the traced hole line by about 0.75 mm.
The horn hub edge (hub radius 3.85 mm about the traced pan hole) reaches 0.8 mm into the board top edge.
